scope: Ordinary LIMIT/STOP/TAKE_PROFIT BBO pricing, including one-way reduce-only and dedicated one-way/hedge position close. Existing compound entry pegs remain separate.
prd_evidence: Futures trading order-type table lists ordinary COUNTERPARTY_1 / QUEUE_1 under Limit, with the same signed V3 endpoint and mode-specific reduceOnly rules. Refetched without a truncation warning.

official_document.refresh: Anonymous raw GitHub read this increment; unchanged document. No private/wallet/RPC/financial probe.
sections: New Order (TRADE): pegPriceType describes COUNTERPARTY_1 / QUEUE_1 and placement/trigger resolution.
Error -5035 INVALID_PEG_PRICE: BBO peg price order requires price to be 0.
Query Order: price and optional pegPriceType fields.

prior_gap_resolution: Earlier notes read the New Order table alone and left the zero-price rule unresolved. This implementation combines its explicit peg field with the same V3 document’s -5035 rule. It does not extend compound depths to ordinary requests or treat a frontend-private request as a public protocol.

placement.draft_price: Empty; zero is introduced only in the wire request.
placement.time_in_force: Preserves selected exchange-supported GTC/IOC/GTX/HIDDEN. No compound IOC restriction inferred for ordinary orders; platform validates final compatibility.
placement.quantity: Exact fixed base-asset Decimal string. One-way explicit reduction uses reduceOnly=true; hedge close preserves original LONG/SHORT and omits reduceOnly. closePosition not sent.
placement.trigger: Original stopPrice/workingType/priceProtect and conditional direction/filter checks remain unchanged. Resolve once at trigger; never Chase.
placement.authentication: Existing current EOA or already-present Privy wallet; same address as user/signer, chain1666 and monotonic microsecond nonce. Actual Aster direct-EOA authorization remains unverified.
placement.dispatch: No automatic send on selection; explicit review, freshness/scope/position guards and durable original-ID log precede one POST. No additional wallet.

query.validation: Exact original peg required; absent/changed/unknown/deeper peg remains unresolved. Fixed-price/market orders reject unexpected nonempty peg. Original symbol/client ID/side/positionSide/type/trigger/quantity/execution/policy and reduction/close scope remain validated.
query.price: Engine determines price. Accept only a finite unsigned decimal string, including documented zero sentinel or an engine-resolved nonnegative price; do not compare it to Mark or the reference estimate. Do not display the draft sentinel as an execution price.
query.completion: POST acknowledgement never proves fill. Signed query supplies status and exact executedQuantity. Failed/mismatched queries retain record and block new orders/config; retries are GET-only.

estimates: Use Decimal Mark for plain BBO and trigger price for conditional BBO, including closing PnL. Explicitly label reference estimates; no selected-book-level or fill-price guarantee. Quantity/filter and trigger checks remain; engine enforces actual resolved price/risk.
ui: Ordinary and dedicated close forms offer manual price / opposing level one / same-side level one.
Separate selection from compound ten-depth entry pricing; incompatible hidden selections do not leak into market/trailing/entire-close/attached requests.
Manual price retained when returning from BBO/market; refresh/scroll/failure preserve selected terms. Sign-out/wallet changes hide old scope.
Review, attempt status and recovery card display the frozen BBO selection and reference-price caveat. Unknown state disables editing and retains original ID.
English/Chinese catalogs and narrow/large-text/landscape/tablet Widget checks; no native verification.

recovery.compatibility: Read strict schema1 and schema2 under original canonical filename; next write uses schema3. Ordinary peg key accepted only in schema3; old records do not acquire a peg. Unknown/malformed keys/values fail closed. Downgrade to older app unsupported.
recovery.content: Public immutable query terms only. No keys/signatures/account snapshots/executable preflight or continuation queue.
recovery.verification: Mock HTTP host-file restart proves saved peg/original ID, conflicting query retention and correct GET-only removal; mobile process-kill/power-loss durability remains unverified.

additional_fix: Listen to complete accountChange state, so equal-timestamp event replay invalidates live-order confirmation during signing; timestamp equality alone no longer permits dispatch.
remaining: Aster actual signer permission, BBO pricing/GTX/IOC/trigger/fill behavior and native wallet/storage/layout/iOS acceptance remain unverified.
Ordinary deeper BBO levels lack documented support and are not offered. Compound entries retain their separate ten-depth contract.
Chase original strategy/order linkage protocol remains missing.
Enable-trading, subaccount management, actual funding/transfers and complete Portfolio remain incomplete; overall PRD goal active.
